data.job_title: Member of Workshop and Seminar Sub-Committee
data.description:
Organized the “AI & Research Enthusiast Program” to introduce students to research in Machine Learning and Federated Learning.
Introduced Federated Learning concepts and encouraged students to explore privacy-preserving ML.
Provided technical support and logistics, including slide management, demo setup, and AV coordination.
Promoted research culture among undergraduates, highlighting career paths in AI and academic research.
Planned and coordinated seminars, workshops, and tech talks, ensuring alignment with club goals and student interests.
Created event documentation, including posters, descriptions, and session agendas, using Canva, Google Docs, and Microsoft Powerpoint.
Managed social media promotion of club events across Facebook and LinkedIn to increase participation and visibility.
Conducted post-event feedback analysis to measure impact and improve future programs.
Maintained databases of participants, speakers, and volunteers, streamlining communication and future outreach.
Handled live streaming and recording of sessions using Zoom, OBS Studio, and Google Meet.
Facilitated panel discussions and Q&A sessions, encouraging student interaction and curiosity.
Guided juniors in joining tech communities, finding online resources, and choosing beginner-friendly research topics.

Successfully completed the highest number of files as a beginner typist, demonstrating rapid skill development and dedication. Recognized by instructors and designers for exceptional performance and commitment to excellence.

data.description: As the Vice President of the National Children's Task Force (NCTF), a prestigious children's organization supported by Save the Children, Plan International Bangladesh, and Bangladesh Shishu Academy nationwide, I have led numerous impactful initiatives. From organizing successful events such as Tree Plantation Events and Press Conferences with Children to taking direct actions against schools lacking proper sanitation facilities, my leadership has made a significant difference. One of the most remarkable achievements includes the prevention of several child marriages, underscoring our commitment to safeguarding the rights and well-being of children.

As a proud member of the Child Parliament of National Children's Task Force (NCTF), a renowned children's organization backed by Save the Children, Plan International Bangladesh, and Bangladesh Shishu Academy nationwide, I have championed the cause of young voices. By effectively raising the pressing challenges faced by children in my hometown to fellow parliament members, I catalyzed meaningful change. The collective efforts led to the implementation of essential measures aimed at enhancing the physical and mental well-being, as well as the educational opportunities, for children in the community. My advocacy has truly made a difference in empowering and uplifting the lives of the younger generation in my hometown.
